items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb]: link 'Hợp đồng' / 'HD-2026-0187' (aria-current). Header shows 'Mã HD-2026-0187', vendor link 'Công ty TNHH Thép Việt Phát', badges 'Đang hiệu lực' and 'Hết hạn sau 56 ngày'; dl has exactly four fields (Nhà cung cấp, Giá trị hợp đồng, Hiệu lực, Đã thanh toán).

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: #btnRenewal 'Đề xuất gia hạn' is the only filled button; #btnMore overflow menu holds 'Chỉnh sửa thông tin', 'Tải bản PDF', 'Nhân bản', and 'Chấm dứt hợp đồng…' (red, after a divider).

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: viewContacts: name + title columns, href="mailto:...", href="tel:+84...", primary gets badge 'Chính'.

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: viewPayments: columns Hạn thanh toán, Số tiền (VND) with 'text-right tabular-nums' and Intl.NumberFormat vi-VN VND; status badge; sort by payGroup rank (overdue 0, due soon 1, rest 2) then date; note 'Mốc quá hạn và sắp đến hạn được xếp lên đầu.'

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: payGroup labels: 'Quá hạn N ngày' (milestone 4, 21 days) and 'Sắp đến hạn – còn N ngày' (milestone 5, 15 days), rendered as text badges.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: Header badge 'Hết hạn sau 56 ngày' with 'Hiệu lực 01/01/2026 – 31/12/2026'; Gia hạn tab: 'Hết hạn 31/12/2026 · còn 56 ngày'.

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: viewAddenda has Số phụ lục, Nội dung, Ngày hiệu lực (dd/mm/yyyy), value change, status, file; there is no approver column. Approver of PL-03 appears only in the separate history tab, not in the amendments list.

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: Empty states with actions: 'Thêm điều khoản', 'Thêm người liên hệ', 'Thêm mốc thanh toán', 'Tạo phụ lục', 'Tạo đề xuất gia hạn' (?state=empty). skeleton() with aria-busy for loading; errorBox() role=alert with 'Thử lại' (data-act=retry) for ?state=error. Weakness: loading/error are panel-wide, not per section, and the history empty state has no action.

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: confirmDlg title 'Chấm dứt hợp đồng HD-2026-0187?', body names vendor, 3 unfinished milestones (1.440.000.000 ₫), PL-03 cancelled, 'Không thể hoàn tác'; buttons 'Hủy' (first) and 'Chấm dứt hợp đồng'. No input in the dialog so showModal focuses the first focusable, the 'Hủy' button (not explicitly set, relies on DOM order).

notes: Clean, restrained admin UI: dense 14px type, 4-6px radii, no gradient except a skeleton shimmer, no emoji, no hero or KPI tiles, no uppercase tracking. Initials avatars are used for real people only. Status badges are semantic colour plus text. Main miss is the amendments list lacking an approver. Audit score 100 though headerPrimaryActions reads 0 (the audit missed the primary button; source shows one). Full-page screenshot was not opened; verdicts rely on source and first-viewport screenshot.
